description: A toy store hires seasonal and full-time volunteers to deliver gifts and gives them points for service. A seasonal volunteer can deliver 5 gifts and gets 2 points. A full-time volunteer can deliver 8 gifts and gets 5 points. The store can only give out 200 points. In addition, a maximum of 30% of the volunteers can be seasonal and at least 10 must be full-time. How many of each volunteer is needed to maximize the total number of gifts that can be delivered?

PointsLimit.definition: Number of points available to distribute

MaxSeasonalPercentage.definition: Maximum percentage of volunteers that can be seasonal

MinFullTimeVolunteers.definition: Minimum number of full-time volunteers required

GiftsPerSeasonal.definition: Number of gifts delivered by each seasonal volunteer

PointsPerSeasonal.definition: Points awarded to each seasonal volunteer

GiftsPerFullTime.definition: Number of gifts delivered by each full-time volunteer

PointsPerFullTime.definition: Points awarded to each full-time volunteer

objective.description: "The goal is to maximize the total number of gifts delivered by seasonal and full-time volunteers"

constraints.description: SeasonalVolunteers and FullTimeVolunteers must be integers
